summary: Togo Voyage lists the countries exempt from visas, essentially the ECOWAS member states, and says all African nationals with a valid passport may enter without a visa for stays of up to 30 days if they complete the immigration form at least 24 hours before arrival. Nationals of the countries on its visa list need an eVisa applied for on voyage.gouv.tg at least 5 days before arrival (Togo Voyage encourages six working days); visas on arrival are suspended. Every traveller entering or leaving Togo by air completes the online immigration form.

faq.question: Do I need a visa for Togo?
faq.answer: Citizens of the countries Togo Voyage lists as visa-exempt, essentially the ECOWAS member states, enter without a visa, and all African nationals with a valid passport may stay up to 30 days without a visa if they complete the immigration form at least 24 hours before arrival. Nationals of the countries on Togo Voyage's visa list need the eVisa from voyage.gouv.tg, applied for at least 5 days before arrival (Togo Voyage encourages six working days); visas on arrival are suspended. All travellers entering or leaving by air must complete the online immigration form.

faq.question: Is the yellow fever vaccine mandatory for Togo?
faq.answer: Yes. The UK government says you must have a yellow fever vaccination certificate to enter Togo.

faq.question: Is Togo safe for tourists?
faq.answer: The UK government advises against all travel to within 30 km of the border with Burkina Faso (except the city of Dapaong and the N1 highway leading to it from the south) and against all but essential travel to the rest of the Savanes region, and says terrorists are very likely to try to carry out attacks in Togo. It also says violent crime, theft and pickpocketing are common, particularly on the beaches and in the markets of Lomé.

faq.question: Can I enter Togo overland from Ghana or Benin?
faq.answer: Yes. Togo Voyage says citizens of its visa-exempt countries must still complete their immigration and health formalities online before presenting themselves at Togo's border posts, especially when travelling by air. Nationals who need a visa must apply online before arrival, since visas on arrival are suspended.
